recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is. If the historical DSTU2 archive URL itself still needs repair, handle that as a publication/archive hosting concern outside the current FHIR source build.
issue_request: FHIR-12948 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 FHIR-core downloads-page issue reporting that https://www.hl7.org/fhir/validation.json.zip, linked from the downloads page, could not be unzipped while the XML downloads were valid.
initial_application: No Jira-keyed commit for FHIR-12948 was found. Historical downloads source did contain validation.json.zip links, and the R3-era downloads reorganization removed the validation*.json.zip links in favor of definitions.json.zip/fhir.schema.json.zip. The Jira comment records this as fixed by the upgrade to R3.
additional_context: The current source/downloads.html page is active in the build hierarchy and lists definitions.json.zip for JSON FHIR Definitions plus fhir.schema.json.zip for JSON Schema. Current source search found no validation.json.zip reference, build.fhir.org/downloads.html matches that link set, and community searches found no human discussion or conflicting follow-up beyond the tracker bot announcement.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No current source edit is needed because the active specification already avoids the broken DSTU2 validation.json.zip artifact, and the current JSON definitions zip served by the rendered build validates as a zip archive.

related_jiras.note: Historical downloads-page reorganization referenced by git history; it introduced the DSTU2 validation*.json.zip links later removed by the R3 download layout.
A separate Published downloads validation-pack clarification surfaced in search results, but it is not needed to decide this corrupt JSON zip report.
